text: Handling deadlines is a crucial skill in both academic and professional life. Effective time management is the foundation, meaning you should break large projects into smaller, daily tasks. Prioritization is equally important; always tackle the most critical or difficult work first when your energy is high. Another key is scope management, which involves saying no to extra requests or avoiding unnecessary details that can derail your progress. Finally, never underestimate the power of communication. If you foresee a delay, inform your team or supervisor early. This transparency allows for adjustments and shows that you are responsible, turning a potential crisis into a managed plan.
